Samira —

Great, glad you're ready to jump in. We can do a working session that includes live prompt review and routing checks, then a focused load window for capacity validation. Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jun 22, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Jun 23, 13:00–15:00
- Thu Jun 24, 09:00–11:00

To scope the load test please send:
- Expected peak RPS and bursts (you said ~300 concurrent; is that sustained or bursty?)
- Typical prompt lengths (tokens in & out), and a few representative sample prompts we can sanity-check before the session
- Whether you need dedicated GPUs for the trial (Dedicated) or are ok starting on Hosted with quota bumps for the test window

Quick notes on the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoff:
- Dedicated: predictable latency and dedicated KV cache performance; better for guaranteed throughput at scale and stricter data isolation. Requires a short provisioning lead time and an SLA commit.
- Hosted (trial): fastest time-to-value; we can bump quotas and isolate via route policies for the load window — lower setup friction, but less isolation and potential noisy-neighbor effects for very sustained traffic.

Ben (cc) will help with the load orchestration (rate limits, quotas) and coordinate the calendar invite. We'll also prewarm caches and pin a quantized model variant for lower token cost if you want that included.

If you confirm a slot and share sample prompts, I'll circulate an internal checklist and attach our network requirements file.

— Soojin

If results show unacceptable tail latencies, we'll scope a Dedicated trial and recommend size and prewarming plan (KV cache priming).
